history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, low-angle shot captures a young woman's face partially obscured as she rests her head on her arm. Her dark hair frames her face, with strands falling softly. Her right eye, dark brown and expressive, is the focal point, looking towards the viewer. Her lips are slightly parted, painted a soft pink. She is wearing a white t-shirt with a black abstract pattern. A bracelet with colorful beads adorns her wrist. Her arm rests on a pillow with a distinctive pattern of thin, dark red curved lines on a cream background. Behind her, a portion of what appears to be a wooden headboard or decorative frame is visible, featuring intricate, carved floral and leaf motifs in a distressed, antique gold and silver finish against a muted blue backdrop. The lighting is dim and warm, creating a soft, intimate atmosphere, possibly from indoor lighting at night or early morning. The overall mood is serene, contemplative, and slightly melancholic. The color palette is dominated by warm skin tones, dark hair, muted blues and golds, and the red and cream of the bedding. The style is candid and personal.
